chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Yahya al-Khazzaz, from Ghiyath ibn Ibrahim, from Abi Abdillah عليه السلام.
Regarding an extra finger, if it is cut off, its compensation is one-third of the diyah of a sound finger.

key_terms.الصَّحِيحَةِ: sound or normal in physical form
key_terms.زَائِدَةٍ: additional or extra beyond the normal number

ai.seo_question: What is the diyah for cutting off an extra finger in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning bodily injury compensation in the case of an extra finger. It states that if an extra finger is cut off, the prescribed diyah is one-third of the diyah of a normal, sound finger.
